system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes seated opposite Dr. Watson in a railway carriage, Holmes in a tweed travelling suit with his pipe unlit in hand","action":"Holmes gestures lightly with the pipe as he speaks, while Watson listens with attentive restraint, both settled into the upholstered seats of the journey back to London","setting":"Interior of a Victorian railway carriage travelling back to London from Surrey, with polished wooden panelling and a window framing the passing countryside","secondaryElements":"Grey English fields and hedgerows beyond the glass; a folded newspaper and a leather valise on the rack; a dark-clad figure dimly seen in the corridor; no visible text","mood":"Subdued, reflective, dry and intimate, with the weight of a sad outcome softened by quiet deduction","timeOfDay":"Morning, under pale overcast daylight","composition":"Medium two-shot across the carriage compartment, Holmes at left in profile and Watson at right facing him, window light falling softly across both"}
